title: MiniKV, Integrated
prompt: Implement kv_init/put/get/del/count/iter, kv_save, and kv_load per the documented format (669-byte snapshot, checksummed) and the error contract. Ownership, replace semantics, capacity, and validation are all graded.

tests.name: core + ownership
tests.hint: Owned keys, replace, capacity as a state — one pass, no partial credit.

tests.name: persistence + hostile files
tests.hint: Snapshot length, tombstone round-trip, checksum verdict, atomic failure.
